status_note: The four targeted projections (helper polarity, init2a_true, camethruposta_slot, zero_path_is_true) are byte-identical MATCH over 22 records, but five condexe areas remain UNTESTED under CONDEXE-TRUEOUT-RESIDUAL-0001, so the fixture-level B2 status is UNTESTED.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: getTrueOut/getFalseOut are zero-argument positional accessors (block.hh:299-300); findInitPre writes the member init2a_true from one pointer comparison; discoverPathIsTrue writes the member zeroPathIsTrue; verify writes camethruposta_slot, posta_block and postb_block. No output parameters; fixture reads the members directly (#define private public on the Ghidra side, #[doc(hidden)] glue on the Rugra side).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: findInitPre walks up two in-edge chains with while((sizeOut()==1)&&(sizeIn()==1)), updating last only on the prea chain; verify fixes prea_inslot=0 before the walk; discoverPathIsTrue has no loop (fixed if/else-if/else order); swapEdges fixes out slot 0 before slot 1.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters; matchflip is a pure boolean composition (complementary XOR op_flip XOR iop_flip, expression.cc:224-230) applied exactly once to init2a_true in verifySameCondition (condexe.cc:93).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: All decisions are pointer-equality comparisons against positional out[0]/out[1] targets; BOOLEAN_FLIP is never consulted by the getters (verified by the H2/F2/F4/Z2/Z4/Z6 flip-invariance records).

overlays.policy: primary file under test; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base copy

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus four hash-verified source overlays; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: One synthetic Funcdata over FixtureArchitecture; no followFlow, no Action pass; synthetic BlockBasic graph plus terminal CBRANCH / MULTIEQUAL ops per case; Heritage::buildInfoList precondition replicated (the real pipeline populates Heritage::infolist during the first heritage() pass, which buildHeritageArray reads)
analysis_options.case_matrix: helper flip x2 + double negateCondition; findInitPre a2prea/a2preb x init_flip x2 + prea_inslot 1 + direct-edge + negative; verify (ib_flip, init_flip) 2x2 over a shared WRITTEN boolean varnode; discoverPathIsTrue zero-on-true/false/condBlock x flip
analysis_options.normalization: Only block creation ordinals (bN) replace raw pointers; every boolean, slot and reverse index is byte-compared

observation_schema.format: 22 fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.helper_projection: getTrueOut/getFalseOut/getOut(0)/getOut(1) targets by creation ordinal, out-edge reverse indices, target in-edge reverse indices, flip bit; before and after negateCondition
observation_schema.findinit_projection: ok and init2a_true booleans (init2a_true omitted on failure: Ghidra leaves it unassigned when findInitPre returns false and the real pipeline never reads it there)
observation_schema.verify_projection: ok, init2a_true, camethruposta_slot, posta/postb ordinals over the (ib_flip, init_flip) matrix
observation_schema.zeropath_projection: zero_path_is_true boolean for the three discovery branches under both flips
observation_schema.preserved: No boolean, slot, ordinal-order, reverse-index or flip field is normalized; only raw pointers are replaced by creation ordinals

build.oracle_archive: Exact locked Ghidra commit archive and locked Makefile libdecomp.a
build.access_leverage: #define private public + #define class struct (ConditionalExecution and the nested MultiPredicate use the implicit class-private section)
build.rust_build: Cargo --locked --offline in isolated target, then rustc with the librugra_sleigh native link

trueout_helper_positional.covers: H1-H4: getTrueOut=out[1]/getFalseOut=out[0] invariant under flip 0/1, negateCondition edge swap and the swapEdges reverse-index fixup (block.cc:218-233/2351)

findinit_init2a_true.covers: F1-F7: findInitPre (condexe.cc:55-75) positional init2a_true for both chain shapes, both init flips, prea_inslot 1, direct-edge shape, and the negative meet-different-blocks rejection

verify_camethruposta_slot.covers: V1-V4: verify (condexe.cc:402-428) composes ib_flip XOR init_flip exactly once into init2a_true (expression.cc:224-230, condexe.cc:93) and derives camethruposta_slot/posta/postb

zeropath_is_true.covers: Z1-Z7: discoverPathIsTrue (condexe.cc:572-582) three branches under both CBRANCH flips (positional getters ignore flip; the flip is consumed once in discoverConditionalZero, outside this fixture)

execute_and_flow_split.covers: ConditionalExecution::execute / doReplacement / removeFromFlowSplit are not exercised (defect F, CONDEXE-CFG-0001)

heritage_gating.covers: buildHeritageArray per-space heritageyes semantics and testRemovability gating are not exercised (CONDEXE-HERITAGE-0004); the fixture only replicates the Heritage::buildInfoList precondition

pullback_storage.covers: pullbackOp newVarnodeOut storage / opInsertEnd placement are not exercised (CONDEXE-PULLBACK-0005)

error_channels.covers: LowlevelError paths (illegal iblock op, missing dominator, non-empty block split) are not exercised (CONDEXE-ERROR-0006)

orpredicate_applyop_end_to_end.covers: RuleOrPredicate::applyOp end-to-end rewrite and discoverConditionalZero flip consumption are not exercised (CONDEXE-FIXTURE-0007)

per-space heritageyes gating (buildHeritageArray) is stubbed in Rugra until CONDEXE-HERITAGE-0004
pullbackOp output storage and insertion position differ from cc:181-187 until CONDEXE-PULLBACK-0005
LowlevelError propagation through the resolve chain until CONDEXE-ERROR-0006
full RuleOrPredicate applyOp corpus until CONDEXE-FIXTURE-0007
